feedback:
This candidate is iteration 9 with one field changed: kd goes from 1.4 to 1.6. Geometry, kp, ki, base_speed, line_loss and sensors stay as in the best raced design (iteration 9, score 619.0). The evidence is a clean single-variable trend at fixed geometry and gains. S-bend progress rose 0.46 (kd 0.8, iter 3), 0.61 (kd 1.0 with y 0.06, iter 7), 0.84 (kd 1.2, iter 8) and 0.96 (kd 1.4, iter 9, 17/20 finished). The oval stayed at 20/20 across that range, with steering_oscillation between 0.19 and 0.20 (iter 7 to 9), so the extra damping has not added visible jitter. Iteration 4 showed that kp 5.5 with base_speed 1.05 cut the oval to 13/20, so kp and speed are the costly levers, and this candidate leaves them alone. Iteration 6 showed that widening the sensor span also hurts the oval, so the geometry stays fixed. Slalom is the weak point: it has been 0/20 in every iteration, with progress flat at 0.143 to 0.15 since kd 1.2, so more derivative is unlikely to fix it. Approve so the race measures kd 1.6 directly; the risk is noise amplification, which would appear as oval steering_oscillation above about 0.3 or oval completion below 1.0.

After the race, read the results in this order. (a) If the oval holds at 20/20 with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.3 and s-bend progress is at least 0.97, kd 1.6 is the new best. Keep it. Use the final iteration to test one slalom lever only, such as base_speed 1.1 with everything else fixed, because the slalom has not moved with damping. (b) If the oval loses completion or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.3, revert to kd 1.4, which is the best raced design, and do not raise kp. (c) If s-bend progress is flat within about 0.02 of 0.96 but slalom is still 0/20, damping has reached its limit. Keep kd 1.4 or 1.6 and test base_speed 1.1 alone on the slalom.
requested_changes: If the oval holds at 20/20 with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.3 and s-bend progress is at least 0.97: keep kd 1.6 as the new best. Then test base_speed 1.1 alone in the final iteration, because the slalom progress (0.143 to 0.15) has stayed flat since kd 1.2 while damping has helped the s-bend.

If oval steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.3 or oval completion drops below 1.0: revert kd to 1.4, the best raced design (iteration 9, 619.0), and keep the sensors at y 0.06. Do not raise kp, since iteration 4 showed kp 5.5 with base_speed 1.05 cut the oval to 13/20.

If s-bend progress is flat within about 0.02 of 0.96 while the oval holds and the slalom stays at 0/20: damping is no longer the limit. Keep kd at the better of 1.4 or 1.6, and test base_speed 1.1 alone, since the slalom has not responded to kd in any iteration.
